units.source_text: 在海浪衝刷的近海岸邊，並排挺拔著二十多棵高大粗壯的黑樹皮的山櫻。

en.t: On a shoreline close to the sea, washed by the waves, more than twenty tall, stout mountain cherry trees with black bark stood side by side.

units.source_text: 每當新學年開始，山櫻便與看似黏稠的褐色嫩葉一起，以蔚藍色的大海為背景，綻放出絢爛的花朵。

en.t: Whenever the new school year began, the mountain cherries bloomed in dazzling flowers against the deep blue sea, together with their sticky-looking brown young leaves.

units.source_text: 不久，到了落英繽紛的時節，花瓣便會大量地飄落大海，鑲嵌在海面上隨波盪漾，然後再次被波浪湧向海岸邊。

en.t: Before long, when the blossoms began to fall like a blizzard, petals drifted down into the sea in great numbers, lay scattered across the surface and swayed with the waves, then were carried back toward the shore again.

units.source_text: 東北地區的某所中學，直接把長著櫻樹的沙灘當作校園來使用。

en.t: A certain middle school in the Tohoku region used that cherry-tree-lined beach itself as its school grounds.

units.source_text: 我雖然沒怎麼用功備考，卻順利地考進了這所中學。

en.t: Although I had hardly studied for the entrance exams, I managed to get into that middle school without trouble.

units.source_text: 無論是這所中學校帽上的徽章，還是校服上的扣子，上面都印著盛開的櫻花圖案。

en.t: Both the badge on the school cap and the buttons on the uniform bore a design of cherry blossoms in full bloom.
